Result.note: replaces try-catch; is an enum, not a class

Option.note: replaces null/undefined; pattern match, never unwrap

String.note: owned string; &str is the borrow (like `string` vs `string &` reference)

Arc.note: shared ownership (thread-safe); replaces shared references in JS

a.match_option: match opt { Some(v) => v, None => return Err(...) }
a.match_result: match res { Ok(v) => v, Err(e) => return Err(e.into()) }
a.channel_recv: match rx.recv() { Ok(v) => v, Err(_) => return Err(...) }
a.serde_derive: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)] pub struct MyStruct { ... }
a.builder_pattern: pub struct Builder { field: Option<Type> } impl Builder { pub fn field(mut self, v: Type) -> Self { self.field = Some(v); self } pub fn build(self) -> Result<T> { ... } }
a.impl_display: impl std::fmt::Display for MyType { fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result { write!(f, "...") } }

x.unwrap() / expect() in library code: ok_or()? / match with explicit error handling
x.clone() to fix borrow checker: restructure ownership: use references, take by value, or Arc
x.Box<dyn Error> everywhere: concrete error types with thiserror, only type-erase at boundaries
x.unsafe { ... } for performance: benchmark first; safe Rust is often fast enough
x.Arc<Mutex<T>> for everything shared: consider channels, actor pattern, or restructuring ownership
x.PartialEq only in tests: derive PartialEq, Eq, Hash on domain types
x.return &String from functions: return &str (borrow); let caller allocate if needed
x.sleep() in TUI E2E tests instead of wait: harness.wait_for_text() / harness.wait_for() — auto-wait, no flaky timing
x.assert immediately after send_key in TUI: harness.wait_for() after every state-changing input; escape sequences have latency
x.hardcoded terminal size only: harness.resize() to test layout reflow at multiple dimensions

t.Copy: marker trait; types must be bitwise-copyable (integers, small types no heap)
t.Display: fn fmt(&self, f: &mut Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result — user-facing, no Debug wrapper
t.Eq: marker trait; total equality (no NaN-like partiality)
t.From: fn from(value: T) -> Self — infallible conversion; impl both From<T> for U and Into<U> for T (blanket)
t.TryFrom: fn try_from(value: T) -> Result<Self, Self::Error> — fallible conversion
t.IntoIterator: fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter — for for x in value {}
t.Deref: fn deref(&self) -> &Self::Target — smart pointer; NEVER for inheritance simulation
t.Drop: fn drop(&mut self) — destructor; deterministic, no GC
t.Send: auto trait; type can be transferred across thread boundaries
t.Sync: auto trait; &T can be accessed from multiple threads
t.TuiTestHarness: PTY-based test harness — new(width, height) → spawn(cmd) → wait_for / send_key / screen_contents
t.AsyncTuiTestHarness: Tokio async variant of TuiTestHarness — same API with .await
t.KeyCode: enum: Char, Enter, Up, Down, Left, Right, Tab, Backspace, Delete, Esc, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, F(1-12)
t.Modifiers: bitflags: CTRL, ALT, SHIFT, META — combine with |
